reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Connecticut
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Are eviction cases first heard in district court?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% The question is asked for Connecticut in 2021.
scenario_state(connecticut).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The scenario concerns eviction cases (Connecticut "summary process" eviction).
% We model an eviction case as a summary process action under CT landlord-tenant law.
scenario_case_type(eviction_summary_process).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario is in effect.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(connecticut),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_case_type(eviction_summary_process).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translation: CT Gen Stat  47a-23a (2020)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
CT Gen Stat  47a-23a(a) (2020):
"... Such complaint shall be returnable to the Superior Court."
We encode this as: in a summary process (eviction) action, the complaint is
returnable to the Superior Court (i.e., the court where it is initially filed/heard).
*/

% statute_ct_47a_23a_returnable_court(+CaseType, -Court)
% Deterministic mapping of case type to the statutorily required return court.
statute_ct_47a_23a_returnable_court(eviction_summary_process, superior_court) :- !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal reasoning helpers
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% first_heard_court(-Court)
% For this question, "first heard" is modeled as the court to which the eviction
% complaint is returnable under the controlling statute.
first_heard_court(Court) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_case_type(CaseType),
    statute_ct_47a_23a_returnable_court(CaseType, Court),
    !.

% is_first_heard_in_district_court
% True if the initial/return court is district court.
is_first_heard_in_district_court :-
    first_heard_court(district_court),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer predicate (must be deterministic)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    is_first_heard_in_district_court,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    \+ is_first_heard_in_district_court,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in district court?
